title: On Bitopological Lie Gyrogroups
content: We introduce and investigate a smooth version of a bitopological gyrogroup, which we call a bitopological Lie gyrogroup. The construction combines the algebraic structure of gyrogroups with two compatible smooth topologies on the same underlying manifold. The first topology describes one smooth structure, while the second provides an independent but compatible smooth structure. We formulate the notions of bitopological gyrogroup, Lie gyrogroup, bitopological Lie gyrogroup, smooth gyrohomomorphism, smooth gyration, and bitopological Lie subgyrogroup. Several structural properties are established. In particular, we study left translations, gyrations, tangent spaces, the two induced differential structures, compatibility of the two tangent bundles, and the behavior of smooth gyrohomomorphisms. We prove that the classical Lie group situation is recovered when all gyrations are trivial. We also discuss the Einstein and M”obius gyrogroups as fundamental examples and explain how their standard smooth topology gives rise to natural bitopological variants. The paper provides a differential-geometric framework for studying nonassociative smooth group-like structures with two interacting topologies. This framework is intended as a starting point for the development of Lie theory, invariant differential geometry, and representation theory for bitopological gyrogroups.
